AccountId.description: ID of the AWS account the stack is deployed to. Terraform refuses to run against any other account.

AppendIndexToDirectories.description: Rewrite requests ending in `/` or without a file extension to append `/<RootObject>`, so `/about` serves `about/index.html`. Useful for static site generators that output one `index.html` per directory.

AwsProviderVersion.description: Version constraint for the `hashicorp/aws` Terraform provider.

DeploymentPipelineV2.description: Deploy the website with the next-generation deployment pipeline. Replaces `IamForCicd`.

Environment.description: Environment name (for example `dev` or `prod`), applied as the `Environment` tag on every resource in the stack.

ErrorObject.description: The object served with status `404` when a requested file does not exist. Not used when `RedirectAllToIndex` is enabled.

IamForCicd.description: Deprecated: use `DeploymentPipelineV2` instead. Lets GitHub Actions in the website's repository (`GitHubRepo`, under the `oslokommune` org) deploy the site. The workflow must run in the GitHub environment `<Environment>-<Name>`.

IncludeLockFile.description: Include a Terraform dependency lock file (`.terraform.lock.hcl`) that pins provider versions.

Name.description: Website name. Used as the subdomain, exposing the site at `https://<Name>.<Environment>.oslo.systems`.

RedirectAllToIndex.description: Serve `RootObject` with status `200` for every request that does not match a file, instead of the `ErrorObject` error page. Needed for single-page apps with client-side routing.

Region.description: AWS region the stack's resources are created in.

RootObject.description: The object served when the site root (`/`) is requested. Also the object that `RedirectAllToIndex` and `AppendIndexToDirectories` rewrite requests to.

S3Backend.description: Store Terraform state in the environment's S3 state bucket, with state locking. Requires the `remote-state` template to have created the bucket; does not create it. If disabled, state is stored locally.

StackName.description: Name of the Terraform stack, normally the name of the stack's folder in the IaC repository. Determines where the stack's state is stored.

Team.description: Team name, applied as the `Team` tag on every resource in the stack.

TerraformVersion.description: Terraform version constraint, set as `required_version` for the stack.

Terragrunt.description: Generate a `terragrunt.hcl` so the stack can be run with Terragrunt instead of plain Terraform. This is an experimental feature and should not be used in production.

cloudfront-static-website-data.AccountId.description: ID of the AWS account the stack is deployed to. Terraform refuses to run against any other account.

cloudfront-static-website-data.AutoForwa.description: Automatically forward any CloudWatch log groups or S3 logs created by this template to Datadog if the current account is integrated with Datadog (via the `datadog-common` template).

cloudfront-static-website-data.AwsProvid.description: Version constraint for the `hashicorp/aws` Terraform provider.

cloudfront-static-website-data.Environme.description: Environment name (for example `dev` or `prod`), applied as the `Environment` tag on every resource in the stack.

cloudfront-static-website-data.IamForCic.description: Deprecated: use the `cicd-common` template instead. `AssumableCdRole` lets the AWS provider assume the environment's CI/CD role, so you can run Terraform locally with the same permissions as the pipeline.

cloudfront-static-website-data.IncludeLo.description: Include a Terraform dependency lock file (`.terraform.lock.hcl`) that pins provider versions.

cloudfront-static-website-data.Name.description: Name for the CloudFront static website data resources

cloudfront-static-website-data.Region.description: AWS region the stack's resources are created in.
